input_contract.description: Retired outward Stripe verification path. Entry was the $29 Payment Link carrying a per-launch nonce and promotion codes. Current Store acquisition is the purchase gate; the installed app no longer requires Stripe checkout fulfillment.

output_contract.description: Historical output: fulfilled checkout state and a minted paid-session token. Current StoreApp has no paid-session token requirement.
output_contract.token: string | null (minted only on a fulfilled checkout)

observation_contract.description: Retired payment gate record. The current entry gate is Microsoft Store acquisition; this portal authors no current plan, report, repair, or entitlement.

evidence_contract.description: Historical Stripe evidence is preserved for audit only. Current purchase evidence is Microsoft Store acquisition/listing state, outside this source archive.

working_parameters.outside_parameters_behavior: No current StoreApp behavior depends on Stripe verification. Any live Stripe object archival/deactivation requires explicit owner approval and dashboard/API evidence.
